# Methods & Operators {#sec-methods-operators}
<style>
#sec-methods-operators > h1 { display: none; }
</style>

This chapter discusses numerical methods and operators available in IPPL for manipulating fields and particles.

- @sec-particle-mesh: Interpolation between particles and meshes (Gather/Scatter).
- @sec-differential-operators: Differential operators (gradient, divergence, curl, Hessian, Laplacian).
- @sec-cg: Conjugate Gradient solvers.
- @sec-fft: Fast Fourier Transforms.
- @sec-nufft: Non-Uniform Fast Fourier Transforms.
- @sec-fem: Finite Element Methods.
